ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 5.6:1 ratio of high-intensity pixels (interior fields) to low-intensity pixels (trailing edges and axial hub).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous zones on both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous band along the trailing edge and an irregular radial cluster at the median notch. A discrete circular low-intensity blob is located in the medial-distal region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped vertex measured at approximately 62 degrees with a vertical depth of approximately 15% relative to the lobe's maximum height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge boundary with approximately 12 to 14 distinct peaks per lobe and an average pixel-amplitude variation of 6 to 10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex parabolic trajectory along the trailing edge leading to tapered distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A discrete circular low-intensity feature on the right lobe; dense irregular low-intensity mottling concentrated at the median notch vertex.
